pkgmetadata.longdescription: Odin is a general-purpose, data-oriented programming language with a batteries-included core library. This ebuild follows Arch extra/odin dev_2026_08: the monthly upstream tag, a clang/LLVM build of the compiler, and installation of the binary next to base, core, shared, and vendor under /usr/lib/odin. LLVM 17-22 are accepted (Arch pins 21). System miniaudio and stb are not used; those collections stay vendored and their Unix static libraries are built at compile time.
